title: Flow Decomposition and Sharp Integral Fujita Criteria on Weighted Graphs
summary: We study the Fujita phenomenon for semilinear heat inequalities generated by variable-speed Laplacians on infinite weighted graphs. Assuming that the graph carries a proper adapted path metric, we establish an integral volume-growth criterion forcing every nonnegative global classical supersolution on the open cylinder $(0,\infty)\times V$ to vanish, without assuming an initial value or trace.
